# Leaflet 1.9.4 (bundled)

`leaflet.js` and `leaflet.css` from the `leaflet` 1.9.4 npm package
(`dist/`), unmodified, with its BSD-2-Clause `LICENSE`.

npm integrity: `sha512-nxS1ynzJOmOlHp+iL3FyWqK89GtNL8U8rvlMOsQdTTssxZwCXh8N2NB3GDQOL+YR3XnWyZAxwQixURb+FA74PA==`

`--animate` inlines these into the contest movie so a saved copy plays without
reaching a CDN. If this folder is missing (for example in a pip install, which
only packages `maidenhead_map.py`), the page loads Leaflet from unpkg instead.
